verbatim_quotes.text: Students freeze on the 1 word they don't know. Teach them to grab the words they DO know (anchors) and let the rest slide like water.
Detective Mode = obsessing over the 20% unknown (freeze). Flow Mode = riding the 80% known (communication).
80% of words = 100% of meaning. The 20% they miss is flavor text.
The Snowman — Metaphor for the freeze response (Fight/Flight/Freeze). The enemy. Students go silent instead of saying 'I don't know.'
Use sales background to read faces. Distrust verbal 'yes' when the face says 'I'm going to die.' 30 programs running = brain crash.
Teach profanity as pragmatics. 'I feel like sh*t' beats 'I feel bad' for emotional precision. Half-fluent students can't navigate real English.
TikTok = engineered dopamine → same chemicals as drugs/gambling. Effortless dopamine kills patience for effortful learning.
If you don't understand the joke at the business dinner, you're the Snowman in the corner. Connection > grammar.
verbatim_quotes.source: BlueTech Transcripts — Humor as Business Survival

verbatim_quotes.text: We have to become a pirate. No excuse for not finding content. Problem-solving is non-negotiable.
Humans Decide. Machines Move. AI as Technical Buffer. Zero Hand-Holding.
Learning AI is potentially more important for their careers than learning English.
verbatim_quotes.source: BlueTech Transcripts — NET PET AI tease

key_concepts.definition: Students grab known words (anchors) in a sentence and let unknown words slide. Shift from Detective Mode (freeze on unknowns) to Flow Mode (ride the knowns).
Freeze response where students go silent instead of saying 'I don't know'. Root cause: Detective Mode crash with 30 simultaneous mental programs.
cure: Prove freezing is worse than wrong answers

key_concepts.definition: Provocation, absurdity, and theatrical chaos to break through Vietnamese reserve and test true comprehension.
TikTok engineered dopamine destroys attention and patience for effortful learning. Scale: older gen 1/2, Gen Z 3/4, Gen Alpha 100%.
key_concepts.cure: No Phone Protocol with 4 social consequences

key_concepts.definition: Western humor = sarcasm, puns, absurdity, double meanings. Eastern humor = logic riddles, literal interpretation. The collision causes the Snowman at business dinners.
key_concepts.fix: Force Western media consumption (The Office) + relentless sarcasm exposure

key_concepts.definition: If phone rule broken, 30-second social consequence: TikTok Dance, Karaoke, Impromptu Presentation, or Tell a Joke.
Reality over Politeness — teach taboo language as emotional precision tool. A student who can't understand profanity is half-fluent.

key_concepts.doctrine: Humans Decide. Machines Move. AI as Technical Buffer. Zero Hand-Holding.
